ingest.compose_hint: Write it here, then review: the same pipeline an uploaded file walks reads the text, writes the summary and proposes where it connects and shows you before anything is planted.
ingest.compose_placeholder: Paste an article, write a note, drop what you just learned…
ingest.compose_title_hint: It names the node and its file.
ingest.curated: The ingest model wrote {n} summary(ies) and {regions} region summary(ies).
ingest.curated_partial: {n} document(s) fell back to a derived summary.
ingest.curated_trimmed: {n} were trimmed to fit the summary budget.
ingest.dense_behind: {n} node(s) have been written since the last build, so hybrid search ranks without them. They are still found by keyword — only the vector half is behind. Refreshing embeds exactly those.
ingest.dense_current: Up to date: all {n} vectors match what is in the forest.
ingest.dense_sub: Embed what changed since the index was built.
ingest.dest_hint: An existing branch. Everything lands under it.
ingest.drop: Drop files or a folder here
ingest.drop_hint: Markdown, text, CSV, JSON, Word and Excel. Tabular files become queryable datasets.
ingest.job_cancelled: Stopped on request. The documents already planted stand; mirroring the folder again completes the rest.
ingest.job_failed: The batch stopped on an error.
ingest.job_lost: This Station no longer remembers that job a restart forgets job records, never the work. The audit trail holds the batch’s record.
ingest.job_sub: The batch runs on the Station. This page follows it navigating away loses nothing.
ingest.model_empty_hint: An empty reply usually means a reasoning model spent its whole token budget thinking. Raise max tokens for this binding, or pick a model that answers directly.
ingest.model_rejected: The ingest model answered, but its summary was rejected {n} time(s) and every summary fell back to the text itself. This is a model, prompt or token-budget problem, not a connection one.
ingest.model_silent: The ingest model never answered, so every summary fell back to the text itself. Nothing was lost but nothing was curated either.
ingest.model_unneeded: Nothing in this batch needed the model — datasets are summarised from their structure and unchanged files are not re-read. {n} draft(s) were passed over. The binding is fine.
ingest.needs_cap: Adding documents needs the ingest capability.
ingest.no_host_paths: This Station reads no host folders. Send your files here instead, or have an operator set MONKEYLLM_INGEST_ROOTS.
ingest.path_hint: Read with the Station’s own filesystem access, which is why this needs the admin capability.
ingest.pick_folder: Choose a folder on this computer
ingest.queue_held_cancelled: You stopped the batch, so the queue is holding. Start the next one when you are ready.
ingest.queue_held_refused: The next batch was refused, so the queue is holding.
ingest.queue_remove: Take it out of the queue
ingest.queue_sub: One batch runs at a time. These start by themselves, in order, when the one running finishes. They live in this tab: closing it lets them go.
ingest.rebuild_hint: The files are the truth and the index is derived from them, so this is the repair for anything that looks out of date: a missing entry, a search that misses a node you can read, a forest that arrived from a snapshot or an older version. It reads every node and rewrites the index. Nothing is written to the forest itself and no history changes.
ingest.rebuild_sub: What finds the content, rebuilt from the content.
ingest.review_none: Nothing was converted from this text.
ingest.review_note: Kept links stay at confidence 0.3, which is the population the Ranger promotes or prunes. A certain link is made by editing the node.
ingest.review_sub: Nothing has been written yet. This is what the Curator proposes.
ingest.review_summary: Summary (the scent every later hop navigates by)
ingest.running: Ingesting this can take a while with a model bound…
ingest.sub: Files become forest: converted, summarised, linked and committed the same pipeline the command line uses.
ingest.sync_blocked: The mirrored folder is no longer one this Station may read. An operator has to widen MONKEYLLM_INGEST_ROOTS, or mirror a folder that is inside it.
ingest.sync_hint: Re-reads the folder you last mirrored and updates only what changed.
ingest.sync_none: This forest has never mirrored a folder, so there is nothing to refresh. Send files, or mirror a folder first.
ingest.title: Add documents
ingest.uncurated: No ingest model is bound, so summaries were derived from the text itself. That works binding one makes them better.
